entities.name: PMID:36232369
observations: Cross-cancer single-cell analysis of breast, melanoma, colorectal, lung, and head/neck cancers identified a shared T-cell genetic signature with tumor-specific differences.

entities.name: PMID:35961204
observations: Pan-cancer analysis described a progressive hierarchical T-cell exhaustion program; exhausted CD8 TILs recurrently express inhibitory receptors including PD-1, TIM-3, LAG-3, and TIGIT, with variable effector dysfunction.

entities.name: PMID:35537413
observations: Across 9,000 human tumors and single-cell datasets, memory/tissue-resident programs were enriched across solid tumors; in melanoma, anti-PD-1 responders had more memory/TRM-scoring CD8 TILs that expanded after treatment.

entities.name: Shared TIL states
observations: Distinct human solid malignancies share broad TIL states: CD8-enriched, antigen-experienced, TRM-like, cytotoxic/interferon-responsive, and progenitor-to-terminal exhaustion continua.
Malignancies differ in CD8:CD4 balance, infiltration density, TRM versus terminal-exhaustion proportions, checkpoint coexpression, clonality, and recoverable effector function.
